title.zh-TW: Read 工具可單次讀取超大文字檔
title.en: Read Tool Supports Reading Oversized Text Files in a Single Call

body.zh-TW: 當你請 Claude 檢視體積龐大的日誌紀錄或長篇資料庫檔案時，常會因為檔案超出單次讀取上限而被迫分段翻閱。⟦如同搬家時遇到整件大型衣櫃，以前工人只能拆解成好幾包分趟搬運，現在只要走道空間夠寬敞就能整件直接搬進屋內。⟧這次替 Read 工具新增了 `allow_large` 選項。只要模型上下文還有充裕空間，而且確實需要完整檔案內容，Claude 就能在單次呼叫中直接讀取超過平時大小限制的文字檔，省去來回拼湊零碎段落的等待。
body.en: When you ask Claude to inspect massive log files or long database dumps, you are often forced to read through them in multiple chunks because the file exceeds the single-read size limit. ⟦Like moving an oversized wardrobe into a new home where movers previously had to disassemble it into several boxes and haul them across multiple trips, you can now carry it straight into the house in one piece as long as the hallway offers enough room.⟧ This update adds an `allow_large` option to the Read tool. As long as there is ample space remaining in the model context and the complete file contents are genuinely required, Claude can now directly read text files exceeding normal size limits in a single call, eliminating the wait for assembling fragmented excerpts back and forth.

items.original: Added an `allow_large` option to the Read tool so Claude can read a text file past the usual size limits in one call when it needs the whole file and the context has room

title.zh-TW: 子代理支援提前自動壓縮記憶並修復中斷誤報
title.en: Subagents Support Early Auto-Compaction and Fix Interruption Misreports

body.zh-TW: 當你指派子代理處理大量繁重的研究分支時，背景助理的對話紀錄常常比主線更快塞滿記憶空間。⟦好比辦公室裡負責剪報的助理，以前必須等整個部門的總檔案夾塞滿才能一起整理，現在可以在自己的小抽屜放滿時就先清空過期紙條。⟧現在你在子代理的 frontmatter 或 `--agents` 參數定義中，可以加入 `autoCompactWindow` 設定，讓子代理比主對話更早觸發自動壓縮。同時，當工作階段關閉導致工具呼叫中斷時，重新啟動的子代理不會再誤以為是使用者按下了拒絕。如果你在自訂代理檔案中打錯了標頭欄位名稱，開啟 `--debug` 時主控台也會直接標示無法識別的欄位，並附上可能拼錯的文字提示。
body.en: When you dispatch subagents to handle heavy research branches, the background assistant's conversation history often fills up memory space faster than the main conversation. ⟦Think of an office assistant clipping newspapers who previously had to wait for the entire department's master binder to fill up before archiving, but can now clear out stale notes whenever their own small desk drawer gets full.⟧ You can now add an `autoCompactWindow` setting in a subagent's frontmatter or `--agents` flag definition, triggering automatic compaction for the subagent earlier than in the primary session. Additionally, when a tool call is interrupted by closing the session, restarting the subagent will no longer mistake the interruption for a user rejection. If you mistype a header field name in a custom agent file, the console will now directly flag unrecognized fields when running with `--debug`, complete with suggestions for potential typos.

items.original:
Added `autoCompactWindow` to subagent frontmatter and `--agents` definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window
Fixed resumed subagents being told that the user rejected a tool call that a session shutdown had interrupted
Improved `--debug` output to name unrecognized frontmatter fields in custom agent files, with a hint for likely typos

title.zh-TW: 工作流程代理可獨立指定模型並支援深層資料結構
title.en: Workflow Subagents Support Independent Model Selection and Deep Data Structures

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案中串接自動化腳本時，可能希望讓流程中的每個任務都統一使用特定模型，而不影響其他自訂代理的原有配置。⟦彷彿工廠特設了一條標準裝配線，以前每位技師都只能依照個別工具箱挑選工具，現在整條產線能統一規格運作，處理多層零件時也不會在中途截斷。⟧新增的環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL` 能讓所有工作流程代理切換到同一款模型執行，其餘子代理則繼續維持各自設定。針對複雜資料，以前工作流程腳本在處理巢狀深度超過兩萬層的結果、代理選項或其他數值時，會無預警截斷內容或產生龐大的任務輸出檔，現在這項限制已獲得修正。同時，Workflow 工具不再拒絕從 Windows 環境簽出、包含 CRLF 換行字元的腳本檔案。
body.en: When chaining automation scripts in your projects, you might want every task in the pipeline to consistently use a specific model without altering existing configurations of other custom agents. ⟦Picture a factory setting up a dedicated assembly line where technicians previously had to choose tools individually from their own boxes, but the entire line can now operate under unified standards without truncating parts across multi-tiered assemblies midway.⟧ The newly introduced `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL` environment variable allows all workflow agents to switch to the same model, while remaining subagents retain their respective settings. For complex data, an issue where workflow scripts unexpectedly truncated content or produced massive task outputs when handling nested results, agent options, or other values deeper than 20,000 levels has now been corrected. Furthermore, the Workflow tool no longer rejects script files checked out from Windows environments that contain CRLF line endings.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to run every workflow agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs
Fixed workflow scripts silently truncating results, agent options and other values nested deeper than about 20,000 levels, and deeply nested results writing huge task output files
Fixed the Workflow tool refusing script files with CRLF line endings, such as files checked out on Windows

title.zh-TW: 企業閘道支援桌面端 Code 政策並修復登入鎖定
title.en: Enterprise Gateway Supports Desktop Code Policy and Fixes Login Lockouts

body.zh-TW: 企業 IT 人員統一部署安全連線時，能透過中央政策同時控管命令列與桌面端工具。Claude apps gateway 受控政策新增 `code` 鍵值，套用與 `cli` 相同設定並在桌面端 Code 標籤頁生效，搭配 `desktop` 還能啟用桌面端閘道模式。若閘道許可提供者包含 `"gateway"`，先前在設定指定該閘道的筆電被鎖在門外的問題已修復。受控設定強制以 `gateway` 登入卻未指定 `forceLoginGatewayUrl` 時，先前登入狀態被忽略的問題也已修正。針對 Haiku 5.5 等自適應思考模型，部分閘道計算 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）失敗或誤計為預算思考的情況已修復。桌面端工作階段若無法啟動，原因現在會直接以回覆顯示。
body.en: When enterprise IT administrators deploy secure connections centrally, managed policies allow them to govern command-line and desktop tools simultaneously. The Claude apps gateway managed policy adds a `code` key that applies the same settings as `cli` to take effect in the desktop Code tab, and pairing it with `desktop` enables desktop gateway mode. When permitted gateway providers include `"gateway"`, an issue where laptops specifying that gateway in settings were locked out has been fixed. When managed configurations mandate logging in via `gateway` without defining `forceLoginGatewayUrl`, an issue where login status was ignored has also been resolved. For adaptive thinking models such as Haiku 5.5, cases where certain gateways failed to calculate tokens (units of text used by AI for processing and billing) or miscounted them as budgeted thinking have been fixed. If a desktop session fails to launch, the exact reason is now directly shown as a response.

items.original:
Added a `code` key to the Claude apps gateway's `managed.policies[]`: the same settings as `cli`, also applied in Claude Desktop's Code tab; beside `desktop`, it turns on Claude Desktop's gateway mode
Fixed a Claude apps gateway that serves `allowedProviders` with `"gateway"` locking out laptops that name that gateway in user settings
Fixed a saved Claude apps gateway sign-in being ignored on machines whose managed settings set `forceLoginMethod` to `gateway` with no `forceLoginGatewayUrl` (regression in 2.1.295)
Fixed token counts for Haiku 5.5 and other models that take only adaptive thinking, which failed behind some gateways and were counted with budget thinking elsewhere
Improved Claude Desktop's Code tab behind a Claude apps gateway: when a session can't start, including on a machine not set up for the gateway's `code` settings, the reason shows as a reply

title.zh-TW: MCP 說明長度上限放寬為兩倍並修正載入問題
title.en: MCP Description Character Limit Doubled and Loading Issues Fixed

body.zh-TW: 當你依賴外部工具擴充功能時，工具本身的參數說明現在可以寫得更詳盡。系統一開始傳遞給模型的前置 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具說明與伺服器指引，預設長度上限已從原本的 2,048 個字元調高至 4,096 個字元。在無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）的工作階段中，切換目錄或重新載入外掛後，以前會錯誤啟動該資料夾原本已關閉的 `.mcp.json` 或外掛 MCP 伺服器，現在已修正。在環境變數啟用中斷回溯時，如果中斷前是由 MCP 工具回傳結果結束輪次，重新啟動後不會再錯誤重跑已完成的輪次。當 MCP 伺服器需要驗證時，雲端工作階段也不會再被誤判為非互動式而跳出無效的本機設定建議。
body.en: When you rely on external tools for feature extensions, parameter descriptions for tools can now be written with much greater detail. The default maximum length for initial MCP (Model Context Protocol, a standard connecting AI to external tools) tool descriptions and server instructions passed to the model has been increased from 2,048 characters to 4,096 characters. In headless sessions, an issue where switching directories or reloading plugins erroneously started disabled `.mcp.json` or plugin MCP servers from that directory has been resolved. When interrupt rewind is enabled via environment variable, restarting will no longer mistakenly rerun completed turns if the turn previously ended with an MCP tool result. When an MCP server requires authentication, cloud sessions will no longer be misidentified as non-interactive and trigger invalid local setup suggestions.

items.original:
Fixed headless sessions starting a folder's `.mcp.json` or plugin MCP server that was switched off for that folder, after changing directory or reloading plugins
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a finished turn after a restart when an MCP tool result had ended that turn
Fixed Claude calling cloud sessions non-interactive and suggesting `/mcp` or `claude mcp` when an MCP server needs authentication
Changed the default limit on MCP tool descriptions sent up front and on MCP server instructions from 2,048 to 4,096 characters

title.zh-TW: 自動模式改善未執行提示並修復工件更新誤判
title.en: Auto Mode Refines Unexecuted Prompts and Fixes Artifact Modification Rejections

body.zh-TW: 讓 Claude 自主執行一連串任務時，操作介面對工具執行狀態的呈現現在更友善。在自動模式下，如果某次工具呼叫因為檢查程序沒有可用答案而未被執行，畫面不再直接亮起鮮紅色的錯誤訊息，而是改以灰暗的「Not run」列呈現。而在雲端工作階段中，若功能旗標尚未載入完成，即使已儲存允許權限，自動模式有時仍會跳過對 Chrome 瀏覽器操作的檢查，這項漏洞現已補正。而編輯自己產出的工件時，偶爾會被系統誤指分享狀態改變而遭到拒絕的問題，也已徹底修復。
body.en: When letting Claude autonomously execute sequences of tasks, the interface presentation of tool execution states is now much clearer. Under auto mode, if a tool call remains unexecuted because checks have no available answer, the screen no longer flashes a bright red error message, displaying a muted "Not run" row instead. In cloud sessions, auto mode previously bypassed checks on Chrome browser actions when feature flags had not finished loading even after permissions were saved, a loophole that is now plugged. Additionally, an issue where editing your own generated artifacts occasionally met with rejections due to the system mistakenly claiming a change in share state has been completely resolved.

items.original:
Fixed cloud sessions skipping auto mode's checks on Claude in Chrome actions that a saved permission allows when their feature flags had not loaded
Fixed auto mode occasionally refusing one update to your own artifact, saying its sharing had changed when it had not
Improved auto mode: a tool call that wasn't run because auto mode's check had no usable answer now shows as a dim "Not run" row instead of a red error

title.zh-TW: 強化指令權限把關並拒絕非 UTF-8 檔案破壞性編輯
title.en: Stricter Command Permission Checks and Rejection of Non-UTF-8 Edits

body.zh-TW: 當你將除錯日誌分享給團隊或執行自動修改程式碼時，系統對敏感資訊與特殊編碼檔案的保護更加周全。⟦好似嚴格的公文保密審查員，以前遇到空白欄位後面的機密附錄偶爾會漏蓋塗黑章，面對非本地語言的古籍更是整篇塗改，現在這些漏洞皆已逐一補齊。⟧在分享的對話紀錄與除錯日誌中，機密遮蔽功能過去若遇到沒有數值的鍵名，接在其後的值或寫在 Shell 字串內的 JSON 可能會漏未隱藏，現在都會遮蔽。安全防護上，若 Bash 指令對 `BASH_ARGV0` 變數賦值隨後呼叫，以前權限檢查可能自動放行，這類指令現在會跳出提示請求使用者確認。而 Edit 與 NotebookEdit 工具遇到 Windows-1252、Shift-JIS 或 GBK 等非有效 UTF-8 的檔案時，以前會把非 ASCII 字元全數置換，現在會直接拒絕編輯，避免毀損原始內容。
body.en: When you share debug logs with teammates or run automated code edits, protections for sensitive information and non-standard encoded files are now more comprehensive. ⟦A strict document redaction officer who previously missed stamping confidential appendices following empty fields and completely scribbled over ancient non-native manuscripts now has every loophole patched.⟧ In shared conversation histories and debug logs, secret redaction previously missed values following empty keys or JSON embedded in shell strings, all of which are now masked. For security enforcement, Bash commands that assign to `BASH_ARGV0` right before invocation previously bypassed permission checks automatically, but now prompt the user for confirmation. Meanwhile, when the Edit and NotebookEdit tools encounter files with invalid UTF-8 encodings such as Windows-1252, Shift-JIS, or GBK, they now outright reject edits rather than replacing non-ASCII characters and corrupting original contents.

items.original:
Fixed secret redaction in shared transcripts and debug logs missing some values that follow a key with no value, including in JSON written inside a shell string
Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving some commands that assign the `BASH_ARGV0` shell variable and then use it; these now prompt for approval
Fixed Edit and NotebookEdit replacing every non-ASCII character in files that are not valid UTF-8 (Windows-1252, Shift-JIS, GBK); such edits are now refused

title.zh-TW: 歷史紀錄切換更流暢並修復特殊分隔符清理問題
title.en: Smoother History Switching and Fixes for Special Separator Purges

body.zh-TW: 在包含大量程式碼的長篇對話中按快捷鍵切換紀錄時，視窗畫面的反應速度現在變得更快。透過快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）語法醒目標示的程式碼區塊，按 Ctrl+O 切換對話紀錄時不再感到延遲。本地垃圾回收機制遇到大型紀錄檔時，若重寫所能釋放的空間低於一成，將不再耗費資源重新寫入檔案。另外，先前當文字內容包含 Unicode 行或段落分隔符號 U+2028 或 U+2029 時，本地垃圾清理會遺失該則訊息，而執行 `claude purge` 也會殘留該提示詞，這兩個問題皆已修復。最後，使用 `--teleport` 時若無法讀取工作階段紀錄，也不再出現開啟空白對話的異常現象。
body.en: When using shortcut keys to switch conversation histories in long sessions packed with code snippets, window rendering is now significantly faster. By caching syntax-highlighted code blocks, pressing Ctrl+O to cycle through history no longer feels laggy. When inspecting large log files, local garbage collection will skip rewrites if the reclaimable space is less than 10%, avoiding unnecessary disk writes. Furthermore, an issue where local garbage collection dropped messages containing Unicode line or paragraph separators U+2028 or U+2029, as well as an issue where running `claude purge` left such prompts behind, have both been resolved. Finally, sessions failing to load history when using `--teleport` will no longer anomalously open blank conversations.

items.original:
Fixed `--teleport` opening an empty conversation when the session's history could not be read
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping a message from the saved transcript when its text held a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029)
Fixed `claude purge` leaving a prompt in the history file when its text held a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029)
Improved transcript toggle (ctrl+o) responsiveness in code-heavy conversations by caching syntax-highlighted code blocks
Improved `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC`: a large transcript file is no longer rewritten when that would free under 10% of it

title.zh-TW: 背景切換中斷未完成指令並修正終端機殘留字元
title.en: Background Toggle Aborts In-Flight Commands and Fixes Terminal Ghost Characters

body.zh-TW: 當你使用方向鍵將當前對話推到背景執行時，背景服務的處理行為現在更加可預測。以前按下左方向鍵 `←` 將工作階段切換至背景時，剛啟動的輪次或以 `!` 開頭的 Shell 指令會在背後默默執行完畢，現在則會立即停止執行。針對輸入時機的異常也做了嚴格防護：若在按 `←` 後立刻送出提示詞且背景服務回應緩慢，過去可能在前景與背景各跑一次，現在不再重複送出。而在啟動階段的掛鉤仍在執行時按 `←` 導致輸入內容消失的問題，現在也能透過上方向鍵 `↑` 找回。在介面顯示方面，全螢幕模式下游標懸停的連結會加上底線提示。開啟 `/diff` 面板時不會再卡住通知訊息。在 MATE 等終端機中複製文字時印出 `52;c;…` 亂碼跳脫字元的瑕疵也已修正。
body.en: When using arrow keys to push an active conversation to the background, background handling behavior is now far more predictable. Previously, pressing the left arrow `←` to background a session allowed newly started turns or shell commands prefixed with `!` to continue running silently, but they are now aborted immediately. Strict safeguards are also in place for input timing: submitting a prompt immediately after pressing `←` while the background service is slow to respond no longer duplicates runs across foreground and background. Input dropped after pressing `←` while startup hooks are still executing can now be recovered using the up arrow `↑`. On the visual side, hovered links in full-screen mode now display an underline. Opening the `/diff` panel no longer blocks notifications. An issue causing garbage escape sequences like `52;c;…` when copying text in terminals such as MATE has also been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed a stray `52;c;…` escape sequence printed on screen after copying in older VTE-based terminals such as MATE Terminal
Fixed toasts and notifications waiting unseen for as long as the `/diff` panel or dialog was open
Fixed a prompt sent just after `←` being run twice, once unseen in the foreground, when the background service was slow to answer
Fixed a prompt sent while SessionStart hooks were still running vanishing when `←` moved the session to the background; it is still not sent, but `↑` now brings it back
Improved fullscreen mode: the link under the mouse pointer is now underlined to show it can be opened
Changed `←`: a turn or `!` command started while the session moves to the background is now stopped instead of finishing out of sight

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集防範特殊保留字並修正跨裝置同步迴圈
title.en: Plugin Marketplaces Guard Reserved Words and Fix Multi-Device Sync Loops

body.zh-TW: 當你從雲端同步外掛或跨作業系統共用設定時，外掛安裝流程現在更加穩健。⟦宛若物流倉庫的貨品入庫登記系統，以前遇到貨品代碼恰好叫「系統保留」的特規件就系統當機，多個分店共用庫存時還會重複下單，現在系統能精準辨識這些特殊命名與同步檔案。⟧過去若市集名稱命名為 `constructor`，執行市集新增、更新或外掛安裝時會引發內部錯誤，現在新增指令會明確拒絕該名稱。同時，名稱為 `constructor` 或 `prototype` 的外掛金鑰，也不會再因為儲存選項而被誤刪。在多個工作階段共用設定目錄的情境下，從 claude.ai 同步的技能過去會在每次同步時重新下載、始終裝不完，此問題已獲得解決。而且宣告了市集相依性的外掛在兩者皆從雲端同步時不會再被誤停用。從 Linux 複製外掛路徑至 macOS 時因指向 `/home` 導致啟動卡住的狀況也已修正。
body.en: When synchronizing plugins from the cloud or sharing settings across operating systems, the installation pipeline is now significantly more reliable. ⟦Like a warehouse inventory registry that previously crashed upon encountering special stock labeled "reserved" and duplicated orders when branch stores shared stock, the system now accurately recognizes these specific names and synced files.⟧ In the past, naming a marketplace `constructor` triggered internal errors during marketplace addition, updates, or plugin installation; the add command now explicitly disallows this name. At the same time, plugin keys named `constructor` or `prototype` will no longer be inadvertently wiped out when saving settings. In scenarios where multiple sessions share a settings directory, skills synced from claude.ai no longer get downloaded again at every sync without ever finishing their install.ai repeatedly downloaded and never finished installing has been resolved. Plugins declaring marketplace dependencies are also no longer mistakenly disabled when both items are synced from the cloud. A startup freeze caused by copying plugin paths pointing to `/home` from Linux to macOS has also been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add`, `marketplace update` and `plugin install` failing with an internal error for a marketplace named like `constructor`; `add` now refuses such names clearly
Fixed a plugin secret named `constructor` or `prototype` being deleted by the next save of that plugin's options
Fixed skills synced from claude.ai never finishing their install, and being downloaded again at every sync, when several sessions share a config directory
Fixed a plugin synced from claude.ai being disabled when the marketplace dependency it declares was also synced from claude.ai
Fixed a startup hang on macOS when plugin paths copied from a Linux machine pointed under /home

title.zh-TW: 外掛 Hook 增加命名衝突提醒並記錄執行耗時
title.en: Plugin Hooks Add Name Conflict Notices and Track Execution Duration

body.zh-TW: 開發或啟用多套外掛時，若有程式碼在背後攔截事件，現在能清楚看見各步驟的執行細節。終端機執行 `--debug` 時，針對工具呼叫、提示詞、工作階段啟動與回應結束的指令型 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），在執行完成後都會記錄其指令、所屬外掛、執行結果與耗費時間，讓你一眼揪出拖慢速度的掛鉤。若有啟用中的外掛因為與其他外掛同名而導致掛鉤被排除，`/plugin` 清單中現在會主動顯示備註提醒。在無頭模式中，同名或拼法相近之外掛已執行過導致後續載入的外掛啟動掛鉤被略過的問題已修正。在輸入 `/clear` 清除畫面後，延遲載入之外掛輸出字串滲漏至新對話的狀況也已排除。若掛鉤輸出文字恰好長得像外掛提示標籤，內容也不會再遭到非預期的竄改。
body.en: When developing or enabling multiple plugins where background code intercepts events, you can now see the execution details of each step clearly. When running with `--debug` in the terminal, command-type hooks for tool calls, prompts, session starts, and response completions record their executed command, parent plugin, result, and elapsed duration upon completion, making it easy to identify hooks that slow things down. If an enabled plugin has its hooks excluded due to sharing a name with another plugin, the `/plugin` list now displays an explanatory note. In headless mode, an issue where prior execution of an identically named or similarly spelled plugin caused launch hooks of subsequently loaded plugins to be skipped has been fixed. An issue where strings from a lazily loaded plugin leaked into new sessions after running `/clear` has also been resolved. In addition, hook output text that resembles plugin prompt tags is no longer modified unexpectedly.

items.original:
Added a note in `/plugin` on a plugin whose hooks are left out because another enabled plugin has the same name
Fixed hook output being altered when it contained text resembling a plugin hint tag
Fixed SessionStart hooks of a plugin loaded after a headless session starts being skipped when a different plugin with the same name, or another spelling of it, had already run
Fixed a late-loading plugin's SessionStart hook output reaching the new conversation after `/clear` in headless sessions
Improved `--debug` output for hooks: command hooks on tool calls, prompts, SessionStart and Stop now log their command, plugin, outcome and duration when they finish, so a slow hook is identifiable

title.zh-TW: 受控 Hook 阻擋工具時正確結束輪次並修復中斷控制
title.en: Managed Hooks Complete Turns on Tool Blocking and Fix Interruption Controls

body.zh-TW: 企業管理者設定安全規則防範危險工具時，攔截工具後的流程現在能正常收尾。⟦恰似安檢閘門，以前攔下違禁品卻沒關閉通道讓旅客空等，現在阻擋時便俐落結束檢查。⟧在受控設定中，若 `PreToolUse` 掛鉤以 `"continue": false` 拒絕工具，或受控 `prompt` 掛鉤攔截請求，回絕後卻未結束該輪對話的問題已修正。部分工作階段中 `PostToolUse` 掛鉤未套用 `updatedMCPToolOutput` 的問題也已解決。提示詞送出掛鉤執行時按 Esc 或中斷，不再導致無頭模式工作階段結束、清空輸入或放行未檢查提示詞。只要 `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` 裡只有單純的變數賦值，PowerShell 指令現在就能讀到掛鉤寫入的環境變數。
body.en: When enterprise administrators set security rules to guard against dangerous tools, the workflow following tool interception now finishes cleanly. ⟦A security checkpoint gate used to leave travelers waiting indefinitely without closing the lane after flagging contraband, but it now shuts down inspection promptly whenever an item is blocked.⟧ In managed environments, an issue where the turn did not terminate after a `PreToolUse` hook denied a tool with `"continue": false` or after a managed `prompt` hook blocked a request has been fixed. An issue where `PostToolUse` hooks failed to apply `updatedMCPToolOutput` in certain sessions has also been resolved. Pressing Esc or interrupting while prompt submission hooks are running no longer causes headless sessions to exit, clears the input, or permits unreviewed prompts. Furthermore, as long as `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` contains only basic variable assignments, PowerShell commands can now read environment variables written by hooks.

items.original:
Fixed managed-settings `PreToolUse` hooks that deny a tool call with `"continue": false`, and managed `prompt` hooks that block one, refusing the call but not ending the turn
Fixed PostToolUse hooks in managed settings not applying `updatedMCPToolOutput` in some sessions
Fixed Esc or an interrupt during a `UserPromptSubmit` hook or a mod's `prompt.submit` hook ending headless sessions, clearing the typed prompt, or letting the unchecked prompt through
Fixed PowerShell commands not seeing variables that hooks write to CLAUDE_ENV_FILE (when the file holds only plain assignments)

title.zh-TW: 外掛模組服務修正執行路徑並拒絕已卸載註冊
title.en: Plugin Module Services Fix Working Directories and Reject Unloaded Registrations

body.zh-TW: 當你撰寫自訂模組擴充 Claude 的內建能力時，模組提供的輔助方法現在能精準對應呼叫者的環境。外掛所提供的 `$` 方法先前會在主工作階段的工作目錄下運作，而非呼叫該方法的代理所在目錄，並且會忽略呼叫掛鉤所持有的輪次，現在已修正為在正確的代理目錄下執行並尊重輪次。在模組管理方面，若模組已經重新載入或遭到移除，但其殘留的掛鉤仍在執行，呼叫 `$.agent.register` 過去仍會成功註冊，現在系統會明確拒絕該呼叫。同時，模組內的網路請求工具 `$.http.fetch` 過去在發送 `HEAD` 請求時，若伺服器回傳的標頭宣告內容長度超過 4 MiB 上限，即便該請求根本不下載主體內容也會被回絕，這項不合理的限制如今已正式排除。
body.en: When you write custom modules to extend Claude's built-in features, helper methods provided by modules now target the caller environment accurately. The `$` method provided by plugins previously executed in the working directory of the main session rather than that of the agent calling it, while ignoring the turn held by the calling hook; it now runs in the correct agent directory and respects the turn. For module lifecycle management, calling `$.agent.register` previously succeeded even if the module was reloaded or removed while its lingering hooks remained running, but the system now explicitly rejects such calls. Meanwhile, the network request utility `$.http.fetch` previously rejected `HEAD` requests whenever server headers declared a content length over the 4 MiB limit even though no body content was downloaded, and this restriction has now been removed.

items.original:
Fixed a plugin's served `$` methods running in the main session's working directory instead of the calling agent's, and ignoring the turn their calling hook holds
Fixed `$.agent.register` succeeding from a mod's hook that was still running after the mod was reloaded or removed; the call is now refused
Fixed `$.http.fetch` in mods refusing a `HEAD` request when the response declares a `Content-Length` over the 4 MiB body limit

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器支援多任務平行操作並釐清註冊錯誤
title.en: Self-Hosted Runners Support Multi-Task Concurrency and Clarify Registration Errors

body.zh-TW: 在公司內部架設自託管執行器（runner）來跑自動化任務時，遇到註冊失敗現在能立即看懂原因。執行 `claude self-hosted-runner` 若註冊遭到拒絕，終端機不再顯示容易誤導的錯誤字串，而是會明確指名是哪項組織管理員設定所阻擋，或者告知重啟的隨選執行器需要新的工作單。在雲端工作階段被拒絕時，錯誤訊息也會清楚說明組織政策為何無法載入，並點出覆蓋了登入狀態的 API 金鑰或授權權杖。多工並行方面，當執行器設定的 `--capacity` 大於 1 時，同一儲存庫有另一個工作階段正在啟動時，既有工作階段執行 git fetch、pull 或 push 過去會失敗，現在已修正。同時，透過 OpenTelemetry 追蹤工具結果時，執行安靜模式提交或指定目錄提交後遺失提交識別碼的問題也已修復。
body.en: When setting up on-premise self-hosted runners to execute automated workloads, failures during registration are now immediately understandable. Running `claude self-hosted-runner` displays clear messages when registration is rejected, identifying the blocking organization administrator setting or noting that a restarted on-demand runner requires a new task order instead of showing misleading error text. For rejected cloud sessions, error messages explain why organization policies failed to load and highlight API keys or auth tokens that override login state. On concurrency, when a runner is configured with `--capacity` greater than 1, existing sessions running git fetch, pull, or push previously failed while another session in the same repository was starting up; this has been fixed. Additionally, an issue where commit IDs were lost in OpenTelemetry tool tracking after running quiet-mode commits or directory-specific commits has been resolved.

items.original:
Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` printing misleading errors when registration is refused: it now names the org admin setting, or says a restarted on-demand runner needs a fresh work order
Fixed a self-hosted runner session's git fetch, pull and push failing while another session of the same repository starts on a runner with `--capacity` above 1
Fixed OpenTelemetry `tool_result` events missing `git_commit_id` after `git commit -q` or `git -C <dir> commit`
Improved the errors for a refused cloud session: they now say why your organization's policy couldn't be loaded, and name an API key or auth token that overrides your claude.ai login

title.zh-TW: Sonnet 5.5 快取讀取費用減半並支援自訂超載重試上限
title.en: Sonnet 5.5 Cache Read Costs Halved and Overload Retry Limits Made Configurable

body.zh-TW: 當你密切關注 API 帳單花費或經常在高負載時段發送大量請求時，這次更新帶來了實質的成本效益與穩定性。⟦類似連鎖賣場調降了常客專屬的會員倉儲保管費，同時在結帳尖峰時段給了顧客自行拉長等候號碼牌間隔的彈性，避免一再被系統退件。⟧系統內的 `/cost` 指令、狀態列、預算上限參數 `--max-budget-usd` 以及 SDK 計費數字，已全數將 Sonnet 5.5 的快取讀取價格由原本每百萬 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）0.20 美元調降為 0.10 美元，足足便宜了一半。同時，當遠端伺服器負載過高而回傳 529 錯誤時，現在可以透過設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS`，拉長指數退避重試的最大延遲上限，讓程式在面對擁擠的伺服器時有更充裕的等待空間。
body.en: If you monitor API expenses closely or send heavy traffic during peak hours, this update brings tangible cost savings and resilience. ⟦A wholesale warehouse club cut storage locker fees in half for its frequent shoppers, while giving patrons the leeway to stretch out ticket recall intervals during checkout rush hours to avoid repeated turnaways.⟧ Across the internal `/cost` command, the statusLine, the `--max-budget-usd` budget limit parameter, and SDK billing counters, the cache read price for Sonnet 5.5 has dropped from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens (the fundamental text processing and billing unit for AI), cutting the cost by half. In addition, when remote servers return 529 errors due to heavy load, you can now set the `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` environment variable to increase the maximum exponential backoff retry delay, giving programs breathing room when communicating with congested servers.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer maximum delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
Updated `/cost`, the status line, `--max-budget-usd` and the SDK's cost figures to price Sonnet 5.5 cache reads at $0.10 per million tokens (was $0.20)

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查結果改為編號清單並優化圖表配色
title.en: Code Review Output Formats as Numbered Lists and Chart Styling Improves

body.zh-TW: 閱讀自動審查意見或請 Claude 繪製統計圖表時，產出的視覺呈現現在更賞心悅目。⟦跟檢查員繳交整齊條列的體檢報告一樣，以前直接丟出一整疊未排版的原始碼讓讀者自行解讀，現在每項缺失都有清楚序號，附帶的圖表讀起來也更加舒適。⟧在雲端工作階段、Agent SDK 以及 IDE 整合環境中執行 `/code-review` 指令時，審查結果以前會停留在未格式化的原始 JSON 陣列，現在會整齊排版成帶有編號的重點清單，方便逐條檢視修訂。同時，內建隨附的資料視覺化（dataviz）技能也進行了介面調優：淺色模式下第七組數列採用更輕盈的淺紫色、深色模式下主要文字顏色變得更柔和易讀，垂直 Y 軸標籤也改採如 1K 這種緊湊簡潔的縮寫格式。
body.en: When reviewing automated feedback or asking Claude to chart statistics, visual output is now noticeably cleaner. ⟦Inspectors hand over an itemized medical evaluation sheet instead of dumping an unformatted pile of raw printouts for readers to interpret on their own, giving every finding a clear serial number alongside more readable charts.⟧ In cloud sessions, the Agent SDK, and IDE integrations, running `/code-review` previously rendered an unformatted raw JSON array, but it now neatly structures results into a numbered list for straightforward line-by-line inspection. At the same time, the bundled data visualization (dataviz) skill received interface adjustments: light mode adopts a softer light purple for the seventh series, dark mode uses a gentler, more legible tone for primary text, and vertical Y-axis labels now use compact abbreviations such as 1K.

items.original:
Fixed `/code-review` ending on a raw JSON array in cloud sessions, the Agent SDK and IDE integrations; the findings now print as a numbered list
Updated the bundled dataviz skill: lighter violet for the seventh series in light mode, softer primary text in dark mode, and compact y-axis labels like 1K

title.zh-TW: Windows 放寬長指令許可檢查並修復 MCP 伺服器退出
title.en: Windows Relaxes Long Command Approval Checks and Fixes MCP Server Exits

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下執行終端機操作或安裝工具時，多項權限與程序管理的瑕疵獲得改善。過去在 PowerShell 中執行長度超過約 1 KB 的指令時，系統總是一律彈出確認視窗；現在已放寬為長度達 32 KB 以內的指令都能正常套用允許規則與唯讀偵測，減少頻繁確認的干擾。在 MCP 伺服器管理方面，以前透過標準輸入輸出運作的伺服器在關閉時會被強制中斷，現在會先關閉標準輸入（stdin），若超過 300 毫秒仍未退出才會終止整個行程樹。安裝外掛方面，未設定 GitHub SSH 金鑰的電腦執行 `claude plugin install` 複製儲存庫失敗時，會自動改用 HTTPS 重試。同時，修正了在略過權限模式下於 Git Bash 執行刪除使用者家目錄指令卻未跳出確認提示的危險問題。
body.en: When running terminal tasks or installing tools on Windows, several permission and process handling quirks have been smoothed out. PowerShell previously prompted for confirmation on every command longer than roughly 1 KB; it now applies allow rules and read-only detection to commands up to 32 KB, cutting down on frequent interruption prompts. In MCP server lifecycle management, servers running over standard input and output were previously killed outright upon shutdown, but the system now closes standard input (stdin) first and waits 300 ms before terminating the full process tree. For plugin installations, running `claude plugin install` on machines without configured GitHub SSH keys now falls back to HTTPS automatically when repository cloning fails. In addition, a dangerous issue where running commands in Git Bash under bypass permissions to delete the user home directory failed to trigger a confirmation prompt has been fixed.

items.original:
Windows: Fixed PowerShell commands longer than about 1 KB always asking for permission, so allow rules and read-only detection now apply up to 32 KB
Windows: Fixed stdio MCP servers being force-killed at shutdown; stdin now closes first and the process tree is killed only if the server is still running after 300 ms
Windows: Fixed `claude plugin install` failing for GitHub `owner/repo` plugin sources on machines with no GitHub SSH key; the clone is now retried over HTTPS
Windows: Fixed `rm -rf /c/Users/<name>` in Git Bash not asking in bypass permissions mode

title.zh-TW: VS Code 擴充套件統一瀏覽器動作確認並修復設定校驗
title.en: VS Code Extension Unifies Browser Confirmations and Fixes Setting Validations

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 編輯器中使用 Claude 側邊欄時，瀏覽器動作確認與介面設定現在更加嚴謹。透過 Claude in Chrome 執行網頁操作時，如同命令列終端機的規範，現在在所有工作階段（包含使用 `@browser` 連線時）執行動作前都會主動詢問使用者。只要在該工作階段內允許特定網站，後續就不會重複詢問。設定檔方面，擴充套件設定中補上了 `claudeCode.spinnerVerbs` 鍵值，讓 `settings.json` 能提供自動補全與格式驗證，格式錯誤的數值也不會再造成聊天面板當機。在 Windows 上點擊對話中完整路徑連結無法開啟檔案的問題已獲修復。當系統或設定啟用減少動態效果時，進度指示動畫會依約定停止播放。而螢幕關閉或遠端視窗重新連線後，面板延遲收到訊息，會讓快取時鐘（判斷提示詞快取是否仍有效的計時）誤判快取仍有效，這也已修正。
body.en: When using the Claude sidebar inside VS Code, browser action checks and interface preferences are now handled with greater rigor. Web operations executed via Claude in Chrome follow command-line terminal conventions by prompting the user before actions across all sessions, including connections via `@browser`. Once a site is approved within a session, repeated prompts for it are suppressed. In configuration handling, extension settings now include the `claudeCode.spinnerVerbs` key to provide autocomplete and schema validation in `settings.json`, preventing malformed values from crashing the chat panel. An issue where clicking full file path links inside chat on Windows failed to open files has been resolved. Progress spinner animations honor system or user settings to reduce motion by stopping playback. Furthermore, delayed message delivery after the display turned off or a remote window reconnected no longer makes the prompt cache clock wrongly read as warm (still valid).

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed `claudeCode.spinnerVerbs` missing from the extension's settings, so settings.json now completes and validates it; a malformed value no longer breaks the chat panel
[VSCode] Changed Claude in Chrome to ask before browser actions in every session, including one connected with `@browser`, as the terminal does; allowing a site for the session stops repeat asks
[VSCode] Fixed chat links written as a full Windows path, such as C:\repo\file.ts or file:///C:/repo/file.ts, not opening the file on Windows
[VSCode] Fixed the working indicator still animating when reduced motion is turned on in your OS, in VS Code, or with the `prefersReducedMotion` setting
[VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock reading warm after the panel caught up on messages late, such as after the display was off or a remote window reconnected

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段支援多重狀態篩選並精準顯示排隊順位
title.en: Cloud Sessions Add Multi-Status Filtering and Display Exact Queue Positions

body.zh-TW: 登入管理介面檢視雲端工作進度或等候執行器派工時，系統資訊的精確度獲得升級。管理員設定中自託管環境的「Activity」標籤頁，現在替工作階段與執行器清單新增了狀態篩選器，支援一次勾選多種運作狀態進行過濾。在任務排隊方面，以前所有等候自架執行器的雲端工作階段都會顯示相同的排隊號碼，現在每個工作階段都會精確顯示前方還有幾組任務正在等待。同時，當 Claude 仍在回覆時若你發送了新訊息，過去回覆生成完畢後你的留言常會莫名跳到 Claude 回覆的上方，現在已修復為固定保持在回覆正下方，重新整理頁面後也能維持正確的對話時序。
body.en: When checking cloud work progress in the admin interface or waiting for runner dispatch, system status reports are noticeably sharper. In the Activity tab under self-hosted administrator settings, the session and runner lists now feature a status filter that lets you check multiple operational states at once. On task queuing, all cloud sessions waiting for self-hosted runners previously reported the exact same queue number, but each session now displays the precise count of workloads ahead of it. Moreover, if you sent a message while Claude was generating a response, your message often jumped above Claude's reply once generation finished; it now stays pinned directly below the reply, preserving proper chronological order even after refreshing the page.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added a status filter to the Sessions and Runners lists on a self-hosted environment's Activity tab in admin settings; you can pick several statuses at once
[Cloud sessions] Fixed every cloud session waiting for a self-hosted runner showing the same queue position; each now shows how many sessions are ahead of it
[Cloud sessions] Fixed a message you send while Claude is still replying in a cloud session jumping above that reply when it finishes; it now stays below it, including after a reload

title.zh-TW: Claude Tag 管理員可自由編輯工作區與頻道記憶檔案
title.en: Claude Tag Admins Can Directly Edit Workspace and Channel Memory Files

body.zh-TW: 團隊在不同專案頻道中與 Claude 協作時，管理員現在能直接掌控 AI 的長期背景知識。⟦正如會議室後方記錄專案決策的活動看板，管理幹部現在可以親手新增、修改或撤下板上的守則。⟧擁有 Claude Tag Admin 權限的成員，現在可以在活動頁面的「Memory」標籤頁中，直接建立、編輯與刪除工作區及個別頻道的記憶檔案。
body.en: When teams collaborate with Claude across multiple project channels, administrators now have direct control over the AI's long-term context. ⟦Like a conference room bulletin board that records project decisions, team leads can now pin up, rewrite or take down its notes by hand.⟧ Members with Claude Tag Admin permissions can now create, edit, and delete memory files for entire workspaces as well as individual channels directly inside the Memory tab of the activity page.

items.original: [Claude Tag] Added creating, editing and deleting workspace and channel memory files on the Activity page's Memory tab for members with the Claude Tag Admin permission

title.zh-TW: Slack 對話串僅最新回覆保留頁尾並修復連結格式
title.en: Slack Threads Keep Footer Only on Latest Reply and Fix Link Formatting

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 頻道中與 Claude 連續對話時，討論串的版面閱讀體驗變得更加清爽。現在 Claude 僅會在對話串中最新的一則回覆保留帶有工作階段連結、模型名稱與費用資訊的頁尾，較早的回覆會自動撤下頁尾，避免畫面充斥重複資訊。此版本亦修復了多項格式細節。網址內包含括號時不會再破壞超連結或開啟錯誤網頁。文字中出現如六位數 PR 編號等類似十六進位色碼的字串時，不再於旁邊誤畫色塊。外掛確認卡片會正確顯示外掛名稱而非內部 ID。頻道未包含的外掛被提及時，會改為說明外掛來源而非誤貼移除卡片。而在自託管環境中任務中途更換執行器導致回覆遺失的問題也已修正。
body.en: When holding continuous conversations with Claude in Slack channels, thread readability is now significantly cleaner. Claude now retains the footer containing session links, model names, and cost details only on the most recent reply in a thread, while earlier replies automatically drop their footers to prevent duplicate clutter. This release also resolves multiple formatting details. URLs containing parentheses will no longer break hyperlinks or open incorrect web pages. Strings that resemble hex color codes, such as six-digit PR numbers, will no longer trigger accidental color swatches next to them. Plugin confirmation cards now properly display plugin names instead of internal IDs. When plugins not included in the channel are mentioned, the system explains the plugin source instead of mistakenly posting removal cards. Additionally, an issue in self-hosted environments where replies were lost when runners were swapped mid-task has been resolved.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Changed Claude in Slack to show the footer with the session link, model and cost only on its newest reply in a thread; the reply before it drops the footer
[Claude Tag] Fixed links to URLs that contain parentheses breaking in some of Claude's Slack replies and task checklists, which showed stray bracket text and opened the wrong page
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude's Slack replies drawing color swatches beside codes that only look like hex colors, such as six-digit pull request numbers
[Claude Tag] Fixed the plugin confirmation card Claude posts in a Slack channel showing a plugin's ID instead of its name
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack posting a card to remove a plugin the channel's own settings don't include; it now explains where the plugin comes from instead
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes losing its reply when a session in a self-hosted environment moved to a new runner partway through a task

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查準確回傳檢查結果並明確提示儲存限制
title.en: Code Review Accurately Returns Check Results and Clarifies Save Restrictions

body.zh-TW: 送出 Pull Request 等候程式碼審查時，上面的 Code Review 檢查標記現在能即時反映審查完畢的真實狀態。⟦就像公文簽核進度，以前主管批閱完了狀態卻一直卡在「審核中」，現在一審完就會直接亮出簽核結果。⟧過去在審查程序完成後，Pull Request 上的 Code Review 檢查狀態偶爾會停滯在「進行中」而未更新，現在已修復為在完成時立刻顯示審查的具體判定結果。同時，管理者在調整 Code Review 的後台設定時，若因為組織政策限制等原因而無法儲存，介面不再只丟出含糊的失敗訊息，而是會明確說明無法儲存的具體原因。
body.en: When submitting a pull request for review, the Code Review check badge now reflects the real status as soon as the review finishes. ⟦Document sign-off progress previously stayed stuck on "pending" even after the manager approved it, but now displays the approval decision immediately once completed.⟧ In the past, after a review finished, the Code Review check status on the pull request occasionally lingered on "in progress" without updating; it now immediately displays the specific determination result upon completion. Meanwhile, when administrators adjust Code Review configuration in settings and cannot save due to organization policy restrictions, the interface no longer outputs a vague failure message, but explicitly explains the specific reason why saving failed.

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed the Code Review check sometimes staying "in progress" on a pull request after the review finished; it now shows the review's result
[Code Review] Improved Code Review admin settings to say why a setting couldn't be saved, such as a policy restriction, instead of a generic failure message

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤阻擋失敗動作，修正重新載入時的防護漏洞
title.en: Hooks Block Failed Actions and Close Shielding Gaps During Reloads

body.zh-TW: 當你加上自訂掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）時，啟動失敗也能阻擋動作。命令與 HTTP 掛鉤支援 `onFailure: "block"`，啟動失敗、逾時或傳回非預期結束碼就阻擋後續動作。深層巢狀工具輸入不再被截斷而漏掉防護。外掛掛鉤背景工作單元重新啟動、模組重新載入期間，原本會繞過另一模組帶有 `.catch` 的防護掛鉤的呼叫，現在會被拒絕。非同步掛鉤分多行印出的 JSON 也能正確讀取；雲端工作階段不再因 `session.receive` 掛鉤先請求權限而卡住。工具執行後若遭外掛拒絕，Claude 與你會得知工具已執行，但結果被攔截。⟦大樓門禁重開機時，以前可能漏查另一道關卡，現在這類通行會被拒絕。⟧
body.en: When you add custom hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), startup failures can now block actions. Command and HTTP hooks support `onFailure: "block"`, blocking subsequent actions if they fail to start, time out, or return an unexpected exit code. Deeply nested tool inputs are no longer truncated to bypass protections. During plugin hook worker restarts and module reloads, calls that previously bypassed another module's shielding hook with `.catch` are now rejected. Multi-line JSON printed by async hooks is parsed correctly, and cloud sessions no longer hang when a `session.receive` hook requests permissions upfront. If a tool execution is rejected by a plugin after running, both Claude and you are informed that the tool executed but its output was intercepted. ⟦Like a building access system that used to miss a second checkpoint during reboots, such entry requests are now rejected.⟧

items.original:
Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through
Fixed a mod's hook being handed a deeply nested tool input cut short with no error, so a guard could pass content it never saw
Fixed calls a mod makes while it reloads during a plugin hooks worker restart getting past another mod's guard hook that has a `.catch`; such calls are now refused
Fixed an async hook's JSON output being ignored when it is printed over several lines
Fixed cloud sessions hanging when a mod's `session.receive` hook asked for permission before passing a message on
Changed what Claude and you read when a mod denies a tool call after the tool ran: it now says the tool ran and a plugin withheld its result

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集安裝與驗證補上警告，誤刪問題修好
title.en: Plugin Marketplace Adds Install Warnings and Fixes Accidental Deletion

body.zh-TW: 管理擴充工具時最怕設定檔載入失敗卻毫無動靜。執行 `claude plugin install`、`enable`、`disable` 或新增市集時，若要寫入的設定檔無法載入，會發出警告。在 `/plugin` 錯誤分頁按 Enter，不再未經確認就移除市集及其外掛。新增市集若名稱無法用於安裝外掛，會直接拒絕；新增或重新整理含大型 Git 子模組的市集時，只抓取含外掛檔案的子模組。子模組是儲存庫內連結的另一份儲存庫。`claude plugin validate` 遇到 README 缺少安裝指令，會印出可貼上的建議，不影響結束碼，即使使用 `--strict` 也一樣。掛鉤模組因頂層 `var` 重新綁定遭拒時，錯誤會指出行號、原因與修法。⟦逛軟體商店時，以前按 Enter 可能誤刪商店與已裝商品，現在會先問你。⟧
body.en: When managing extensions, silent configuration load failures can cause unexpected issues. Running `claude plugin install`, `enable`, `disable`, or adding a marketplace now issues a warning if the target configuration file fails to load. Pressing Enter on the `/plugin` error tab no longer removes the marketplace and its plugins without confirmation. Adding a marketplace is rejected if its name cannot be used to install plugins; adding or refreshing marketplaces with large Git submodules now fetches only submodules containing plugin files. Submodules are separate repositories nested inside a repository. When `claude plugin validate` finds a README missing install instructions, it prints pasteable suggestions without affecting the exit code, even when using `--strict`. When a hook module is rejected due to top-level `var` rebinding, the error message indicates the line number, reason, and remediation. ⟦Picture browsing an app store where pressing Enter used to delete the store and installed items; it now asks for confirmation first.⟧

items.original:
Added a warning to `claude plugin install`, `enable`, `disable` and `marketplace add` when the settings file they write to does not load
Added advice to `claude plugin validate` when a plugin's README has no install line: it prints the line to paste and never changes the exit code, even with `--strict`
Fixed `/plugin`'s Errors tab removing a marketplace that failed to load, and uninstalling its plugins, on Enter without asking first
Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add` reporting success for a marketplace whose name no plugin can be installed under; such an add is now refused
Fixed plugin marketplaces whose repository has large git submodules failing to add or refresh: only the submodules that hold plugin files are now fetched
Improved `claude plugin validate` and plugin loading: when a hooks module is refused over a rebound top-level `var`, the error now names the line that rebinds it, the cause, and a fix

title.zh-TW: 模組介面按鈕更豐富，通知優先權與編寫引導升級
title.en: Richer Module UI Buttons with Upgraded Notification Priorities and Authoring Guidance

body.zh-TW: 開發或使用自訂介面模組時，資訊排版與提醒層級現在更有彈性。模組現在可透過 `$.ui.notify` 發送符合系統設定的原生桌面通知，並明確標記發送來源。按鈕元件支援放入文字子節點，方便在單一可點擊按鈕內呈現標籤或次要細節。由所屬組織發布的彈出提示（toast）會排在其他模組前面優先顯示。內建的外掛編寫技能在沒有終端機的工作階段中不再要求執行指令，並僅在被詢問時才解說分享流程；Workflow（工作流程工具）拒絕 `scriptPath` 時，會提示改用 `script` 行內傳入腳本，這種方式可在沒有 Read 讀取工具的工作階段使用。
body.en: When building or using custom UI modules, layout and alerting options are now more flexible. Modules can now deliver native desktop notifications via `$.ui.notify` respecting system preferences and clearly attributing the source. Button components support text child nodes, allowing labels or secondary details to be rendered within a single clickable button. Toast popups published by your organization are prioritized ahead of other modules. The built-in plugin authoring skill no longer prompts to run commands in sessions without a terminal and only explains sharing flows when asked. When Workflow (a workflow tool) rejects `scriptPath`, it prompts you to use `script` to pass inline scripts instead, which works in sessions without Read tools.

items.original:
Added `$.ui.notify` for mods: raises a native notification through your own notification setting and says which channel sent it
Added children to a mod's `Button`: strings and `Text`, so a row of a list is one pressable with a chip or a dim detail inside
Improved the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill: it no longer tells a session with no terminal to run terminal commands, and explains sharing a mod only when asked
Improved the Workflow tool's `scriptPath` refusal: it now says to pass the script inline via `script`, the route that works in sessions without a Read tool
Changed toasts from your organization's mods to show ahead of other mods' toasts instead of waiting behind them

title.zh-TW: 外掛熱重載補上漏接存檔，不再反覆跳出確認詢問
title.en: Plugin Hot Reload Captures Missed Saves and Stops Repeated Confirmation Prompts

body.zh-TW: 在修改擴充模組並即時查看效果時，漏接存檔可能讓你仍看到舊版本。熱重載（hot reload，修改程式碼後不重啟即時生效的技術）已修好兩種漏接：`/reload-plugins` 或工作階段啟動正在讀取模組檔案時存檔，以及上次重載後幾毫秒內再次存檔。重載詢問直接放行但未選答案後，不再每回合重複出現；SDK 宿主若在回答前關閉詢問，詢問最多會出現三次，不再整個工作階段都關閉熱重載。外掛選項命名為 `constructor` 或 `prototype` 時，不再一直讀到預設值，編輯後也能重新載入。加入大型介面的外掛，在外掛掛鉤背景工作單元停滯時，不再使另一個外掛被卸載。
body.en: When modifying extension modules and inspecting changes in real time, missed file saves can leave you looking at outdated code. Hot reload (applying code changes immediately without restarting) has fixed two missed save cases: saving files while `/reload-plugins` or session startup is reading module files, and saving again within milliseconds of the previous reload. Reload prompts allowed without an explicit selection no longer recur every turn. If an SDK host dismisses prompts before answering, the prompt appears up to three times rather than disabling hot reload for the entire session. Plugin options named `constructor` or `prototype` no longer continuously read default values and reload cleanly after edits. Plugins with large UI surfaces no longer cause another plugin to unload when a plugin hook worker stalls.

items.original:
Fixed plugin options named `constructor` or `prototype` always reading as their default and never reloading the plugin when edited
Fixed a mod's hot reload missing a save made while `/reload-plugins` or session start was reading the mod's files
Fixed the mod hot-reloading question being asked again every turn for the whole session when it is approved without picking an answer
Fixed a mod's hot reload missing a save made within a few milliseconds of its last reload, which left the mod on its old version until the next save
Fixed mod hot-reloading turning off for the whole session when an SDK host closed its enable question before anyone answered; the question is now asked up to three times
Fixed a plugin that adds very large interfaces getting another plugin unloaded when the plugin hooks worker stalls

title.zh-TW: 外掛設定變更嚴格受檢，提示詞歷程不再殘留無效內容
title.en: Plugin Config Changes Strictly Inspected and Prompt History Cleared of Invalid Entries

body.zh-TW: 透過外掛管控對話設定或改寫輸入時，設定與記錄應該反映外掛的決定。使用 `/model`、`/fast`、`/output-style` 或在 `/config` 切換自動更新管道，會先詢問 `config.set` 掛鉤（特定事件觸發的小程式），再儲存設定。`prompt.submit` 掛鉤改寫或捨棄輸入後，提示詞歷程與對話記錄中的待發送提示詞紀錄，不再保存改寫或捨棄前的原始輸入。`claude plugin test` 不再錯誤放行會移除工具呼叫、工具結果或思考區塊的 `session.append` 掛鉤，這些區塊在真實工作階段會保留。`-p` 與 SDK 工作階段不再把產生的型別檔寫入 `--plugin-dir` 外掛資料夾，只寫到正在開發模組的位置。掛鉤模組程式碼巢狀數千層時，載入或驗證失敗並只顯示堆疊溢位訊息的問題也已修好。
body.en: When managing session settings or rewriting inputs via plugins, configs and histories should reflect plugin decisions. Using `/model`, `/fast`, `/output-style`, or toggling auto-update channels in `/config` now consults `config.set` hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) before persisting settings. After a `prompt.submit` hook rewrites or discards input, prompt history and session pending prompt logs no longer retain the original input prior to rewriting or discarding. `claude plugin test` no longer erroneously passes `session.append` hooks that strip tool calls, tool results, or thinking blocks, which are preserved in real sessions. Headless `-p` and SDK sessions no longer write generated type definitions to the `--plugin-dir` folder, writing only to the module location under active development. An issue where hook module code nested thousands of levels deep failed loading or validation with only a stack overflow error has also been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed plugins whose hooks module nests code thousands of levels deep failing to load or validate with a bare stack-overflow message
Fixed `claude plugin test` passing a `session.append` hook that removes tool call, tool result or thinking blocks that a real session keeps
Fixed `/model`, `/fast` and `/output-style` saving their setting without asking a plugin's `config.set` hook
Fixed generated type files being written into a `--plugin-dir` plugin's folder in `-p` and SDK sessions; they are now written only where a mod is being developed
Fixed a prompt that a mod's `prompt.submit` hook rewrote or dropped still being saved as typed to prompt history and to the transcript's queued-prompt records
Fixed changing the auto-update channel in `/config` saving before a plugin's `config.set` hook was asked

title.zh-TW: Windows 外掛載入與安裝紀錄修正，快取誤判修好
title.en: Windows Plugin Loading and Install Records Fixed Along with Cache Misclassification

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境或多個連線環境間使用外掛時，可能遇到路徑與管理歸屬判斷錯誤。VS Code 在 Windows 上因磁碟代號大小寫不同而無法載入專案範圍外掛的問題已修好。Windows 的 `plugin install`、`uninstall` 在專案或本機範圍操作時，也不再因 `C:` 與 `c:` 這類差異漏掉安裝紀錄或新增重複紀錄。長時間運作的工作階段，在另一個工作階段同步 claude.ai 外掛更新後，掛鉤不再錯報「Plugin directory does not exist」。託管設定會列出或啟用外掛的機器上，遭竄改的伺服器託管設定快取（把查過的資料暫存起來直接用）將個人外掛誤判為組織管理外掛的問題也已修好。
body.en: When using plugins on Windows or across multiple connection environments, path and governance misclassifications can arise. An issue where VS Code on Windows failed to load project-scoped plugins due to drive letter casing mismatches has been fixed. Windows operations with `plugin install` and `uninstall` in project or local scopes no longer drop install records or add duplicates because of `C:` versus `c:` differences. In long-running sessions, hooks no longer falsely report "Plugin directory does not exist" after another session syncs claude.ai plugin updates. On machines where managed configurations list or enable plugins, a bug where a tampered server-managed config cache misclassified personal plugins as organization-managed plugins has also been resolved.

items.original:
Fixed a tampered cache of server-managed settings making a person's own plugin count as organization-managed on machines whose managed settings list or enable plugins
Fixed project-scope plugins not loading in VS Code on Windows due to drive-letter casing (anthropics/claude-code#74612)
Fixed `plugin install` and `uninstall` at project or local scope on Windows missing the install record, or adding a second one, when only the drive letter's case differs
Fixed claude.ai-synced plugin hooks failing with "Plugin directory does not exist" in long-running sessions after another session synced a plugin update

title.zh-TW: 企業閘道支援串流逾時控制，模型清單也限制備援轉送
title.en: Enterprise Gateway Adds Streaming Timeouts and Restricts Fallback Forwarding by Model List

body.zh-TW: 企業透過閘道轉送雲端模型請求時，可以限制等待與模型去向。`timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms` 可設定 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 等上游的串流開始等待毫秒數，逾時就切換備援（主通道失敗時接手的替代方案）或回傳 502。每個上游可設 `models` 清單，只轉送列出的模型，備援轉送也受限制；每個項目中的一個 `*` 可作萬用字元。Amazon Bedrock 位於 AWS 美國地理區域以外時，未列於 `models:` 的模型請求原本會被 AWS 拒絕；閘道現在會嘗試你自己的區域，若仍遭拒，會指出需加入的模型。背景請求優先使用 Haiku 4.5，閘道未提供時才退回工作階段原本的模型。⟦物流中心以前改走備用線可能漏查貨物名單，現在換線也得照名單分派。⟧
body.en: When enterprises route cloud model requests through a gateway, they can constrain wait times and model destinations. `timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms` configures the time-to-first-byte waiting threshold in milliseconds for upstreams like Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, switching to fallbacks or returning a 502 on timeout. Each upstream can define a `models` list to route only listed models, which also constrains fallback routing; a single `*` in each entry acts as a wildcard. When Amazon Bedrock is located outside AWS US regions, model requests not listed under `models:` were previously rejected by AWS; the gateway now tries your own region and, if still rejected, identifies which model needs to be added. Background requests prioritize Haiku 4.5, falling back to the session's original model only when the gateway does not provide it. ⟦Think of a logistics center that used to overlook cargo manifests when switching to backup routes; line changes must now dispatch strictly according to the manifest.⟧

items.original:
Added support for `timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms` on the Claude apps gateway's Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other cloud upstreams: a value you set now limits how long a stream may take to start there, after which it fails over or gets a 502
Added an optional `models` list to every Claude apps gateway upstream: only the listed models are sent there, on failover too, and one `*` in an entry is a wildcard
Improved background requests behind a Claude apps gateway to use Haiku 4.5 instead of the session's model, falling back to the session's model where the gateway does not serve Haiku 4.5
Improved how the Claude apps gateway handles models not listed under `models:` in Amazon Bedrock regions outside AWS's US geography. AWS always refused those requests; the gateway now tries the model in your own region, and a refusal names the model to add

title.zh-TW: 企業閘道強化登入強制導向，審計紀錄精準串聯雲端請求
title.en: Enterprise Gateway Enforces Login Redirection and Links Audit Logs to Cloud Requests

body.zh-TW: 如果企業需要集中管控員工的登入管道與使用軌跡，可以設定登入去向並比對請求紀錄。沒有託管設定的機器，可在使用者設定加入 `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` 與 `forceLoginGatewayUrl`，讓 `/login` 開啟指定閘道。模型推論的審計紀錄新增 `upstream_request_id`，成功回應標頭加入 `request-id`，方便對照雲端上游、閘道日誌與 Claude Code 遙測。機器已設定 OpenTelemetry（收集監控資料的標準），或工作階段已登入閘道時，登入驗證事件能正確匯出。若遇到內附 Claude Desktop 結構定義尚不認識的 `desktop` 原則鍵，閘道會帶著警告啟動並提供該設定，不必為這類新桌面設定升級閘道。
body.en: Enterprises needing centralized governance over employee login channels and usage trails can configure login destinations and correlate request logs. Machines without managed configurations can add `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` and `forceLoginGatewayUrl` in user settings to direct `/login` to the designated gateway. Model inference audit logs now include `upstream_request_id`, and successful response headers append `request-id` to facilitate cross-referencing between cloud upstreams, gateway logs, and Claude Code telemetry. When a machine has OpenTelemetry (a standard for collecting monitoring data) configured or a session is logged into the gateway, login authentication events are properly exported. If the gateway encounters `desktop` policy keys not yet recognized by the bundled Claude Desktop schema, it starts with a warning and serves the configuration without requiring a gateway upgrade for new desktop settings.

items.original:
Added support for `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` and `forceLoginGatewayUrl` in your own user settings on machines with no managed settings, so `/login` opens on that Claude apps gateway
Added `upstream_request_id` to the Claude apps gateway's `inference` audit event: the request ID from Amazon Bedrock, the Anthropic API or another upstream, for support cases
Added a `request-id` header to the Claude apps gateway's successful inference responses, so `request_id` in Claude Code telemetry matches the gateway's audit log
Fixed the `claude_code.auth` OpenTelemetry login event not being emitted on Claude apps gateway sign-in. The event is exported when OpenTelemetry is configured on the machine or the session is already signed in to the gateway
Changed the Claude apps gateway to start with a warning and serve a `desktop` policy key its bundled Claude Desktop schema doesn't know, so new Desktop settings need no gateway upgrade

title.zh-TW: 企業閘道改用 AWS CountTokens，花費上限與 Fable 選單修正
title.en: Enterprise Gateway Adopts AWS CountTokens and Fixes Spend Limits and Fable Menus

body.zh-TW: 管理員查看閘道用量時，工作階段移出群組後不再殘留舊群組與花費上限。Amazon Bedrock 閘道改用 AWS CountTokens API 計算權杖（token，AI 處理與計費的文字單位），取代向模型請求單一權杖的方式，供 `/context` 與大檔讀取使用；需授予 `bedrock:CountTokens` 權限。PostgreSQL 資料庫處於唯讀狀態時，每 30 秒記錄警告，說明哪些操作失敗及如何復原。`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` 不再隱藏 `/usage` 與狀態列的閘道花費上限，花費上限請求會送往目前工作階段登入的閘道。已登入閘道的工作階段，`availableModels` 中的 Fable 模型現在會顯示於 `/model` 選單，以內建列取代同模型的 `modelPicker` 列。
body.en: When administrators review gateway usage, sessions moved out of a group no longer retain stale groups or spend limits. The Amazon Bedrock gateway now uses the AWS CountTokens API to calculate tokens (text units used for AI processing and billing) instead of requesting a single token from the model, serving `/context` and large file reads; this requires granting `bedrock:CountTokens` permissions. When the PostgreSQL database enters a read-only state, warnings are logged every 30 seconds detailing failed operations and remediation steps. `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` no longer hides gateway spend limits from `/usage` and the status line, and spend limit requests are routed to the gateway logged into by the current session. For sessions logged into a gateway, Fable models in `availableModels` are now displayed in the `/model` menu, replacing `modelPicker` rows with built-in rows for the same model.

items.original:
Fixed Fable models listed in `availableModels` not appearing in the `/model` picker for sessions signed in to a Claude apps gateway; such a model now shows its built-in row in place of a `modelPicker` row added for the same model
Fixed the Claude apps gateway's admin spend view showing a developer's old groups and group cap after their session stopped carrying groups
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` hiding the Claude apps gateway spend limit in `/usage` and the status line. The spend limit request goes to the gateway the session is signed in to
Improved token counts behind a Claude apps gateway on Amazon Bedrock, which `/context` and large file reads use: the gateway now gets them from AWS's CountTokens API instead of a one-token model request. Grant `bedrock:CountTokens` to use it
Improved the Claude apps gateway to log a warning every 30 seconds while its PostgreSQL database is read-only, saying what fails and how to recover

title.zh-TW: 基礎工具參數解析更寬容，權限受限模式嚴格受控
title.en: Core Tool Parameter Parsing Loosened and Restricted Modes Strictly Controlled

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 執行命令或讀取檔案時，參數小差異不再直接卡住工具。Bash（執行終端機命令的工具）收到 `command_description` 而非 `description` 時不再失敗；Read 收到空的 `pages` 參數會視為未填。Grep 搜尋支援附帶 `-l`、`-c`、`-r` 旗標，不再因此呼叫失敗。`--tools` 與 `--restricted` 的限制會套用到啟動後才註冊的內建工具，已棄用的工具名稱也不再繞過呼叫者的工具集合。Bash 對萬用字元迴圈的權限檢查已修正。無法取得功能旗標（控制功能是否開啟的開關）時，Claude 3 Opus、Claude 3.x Sonnet 工作階段不再被提供它們會拒絕的工具搜尋。
body.en: When having AI execute commands or read files, minor parameter differences no longer break tool invocations. Bash (a tool for running terminal commands) no longer fails when receiving `command_description` instead of `description`; Read treats an empty `pages` parameter as unset. Grep searches now support appending `-l`, `-c`, and `-r` flags without causing call failures. Restrictions from `--tools` and `--restricted` apply to built-in tools registered after startup, and deprecated tool names no longer bypass caller toolsets. Bash permission checks for wildcard loops have been fixed. When feature flags (switches controlling whether features are enabled) cannot be retrieved, Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3.x Sonnet sessions are no longer offered tool searches they would otherwise reject.

items.original:
Fixed Bash tool calls failing when the model passes `command_description` instead of `description`
Fixed `--tools` and `--restricted` not applying to built-in tools that register after launch, and deprecated tool names reaching tools outside the caller's tool set
Fixed Bash permission checks for for-loops over glob patterns, improving permission-check accuracy
Fixed Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3.x Sonnet sessions being offered tool search, which those models reject, where feature flags are unavailable
Fixed the Read tool rejecting calls with an empty `pages` parameter instead of treating it as omitted
Improved Grep input handling: a search sent with grep's `-l`, `-c` or `-r` flag now runs instead of failing the call

title.zh-TW: 百萬上下文請求智慧降級，檔案變更偵測不再誤判已讀
title.en: Smart Fallback for 1-Million Context Requests and Accurate File Change Detection

body.zh-TW: 當處理龐大程式碼庫或超長上下文時，系統與模型之間的溝通更加穩健。使用標記百萬上下文（`[1m]`）的模型時，若雲端平台拒絕該測試旗標，系統會自動移除旗標並重新發送請求，避免整批請求直接失敗。在檔案讀寫方面，即使檔案修改時間未更新但內容已變動，或是終端機指令未印出內容，編輯工具都不會誤以為檔案已經完整讀取過。大型檔案上傳失敗且未提供原因時，Claude 得到的說明已改善，會回報失敗而不縮小檔案。`xhigh` 與 `max` 思考力度下，網路搜尋及 `agent` 掛鉤（特定事件觸發的小程式）評估耗時過長的問題已修好。
body.en: Communication between the system and models is more resilient when handling massive codebases or very long contexts. When using models tagged with 1-million context (`[1m]`), if the cloud platform rejects the test flag, the system automatically removes the flag and resends the request so the entire batch does not immediately fail. For file reading and writing, editor tools no longer assume a file has been read in its entirety if the modified timestamp remains unchanged despite content updates, or if a terminal command produces no output. When large file uploads fail without a specified reason, the explanation given to Claude is improved, reporting failure rather than shrinking the file. Issues where web searches and `agent` hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) took excessively long to evaluate under `xhigh` and `max` thinking efforts have been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed every request failing on a `[1m]` model when a gateway, Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry refuses the context-1m beta; Claude Code now resends without it
Fixed a file being treated as already read after a Bash command such as `cat` ran without printing it
Fixed Edit treating a file as fully read when its contents changed without its modification time advancing
Improved what Claude is told when a large file it sends fails to upload with no reason given, so it reports the failure instead of shrinking the file
Fixed web searches and `agent` hook evaluations taking much longer at `xhigh` and `max` effort

title.zh-TW: 外部工具採用退避重連，長時間斷線後可再連線
title.en: Backoff Reconnection for External Tools and Recovery from Extended Disconnects

body.zh-TW: 在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）或 SDK 程式整合中連接遠端工具時，斷線後不再一直離線。遠端 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器中斷超過 15 秒後無法重連的問題已修好；反覆連上就斷線時，重連間隔會逐步拉長，最多 30 秒。伺服器錯誤回覆含網路錯誤名稱，不再使連線被誤切斷；分頁指標重複也不再反覆索取同頁。等待資源清單時按中斷鍵，能結束回合而無需等逾時。WebSocket 傳輸收到超過 16 MiB 的訊息，不再解析並會關閉連線，與其他傳輸方式的上限一致。⟦猶如撥打客服專線，以前接通就斷線仍急著重撥，現在會拉長間隔再試。⟧
body.en: Connecting to remote tools in headless mode (an execution mode without a terminal window) or SDK integrations no longer remains permanently offline after a disconnection. An issue where remote MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) servers failed to reconnect after disconnecting for over 15 seconds has been fixed. When connections drop repeatedly right after connecting, reconnection intervals now back off progressively up to 30 seconds. Server error responses containing network error names no longer mistakenly terminate connections, and duplicate pagination cursors no longer fetch the same page repeatedly. Pressing interrupt while awaiting resource lists now terminates the turn without waiting for timeouts. WebSocket transports receiving messages over 16 MiB now skip parsing and close the connection, matching limits on other transports. ⟦Dialing a customer service hotline now spaces out retries instead of rushing to redial whenever a call drops right after connecting.⟧

items.original:
Fixed remote MCP servers in headless and SDK sessions staying disconnected after an outage longer than 15 seconds, or reconnecting in a tight loop to a server that drops each connection right after it connects; repeated drops now back off, up to 30s
Fixed remote MCP connections being dropped when a server's error reply happened to contain a network error name
Fixed MCP servers that repeat a pagination cursor being asked for the same page up to 20 times at every connect
Fixed an interrupt not ending the turn until a timeout while Claude waited for an MCP server's resource list
Changed WebSocket (`ws`) MCP servers: a message over 16 MiB is no longer parsed and closes the connection, the limit the other transports already have

title.zh-TW: 外部工具檔案型別精準辨識，工具說明長度上限放寬
title.en: Precise File Type Detection for External Tools and Expanded Tool Description Limits

body.zh-TW: 透過外部工具回傳程式碼、樣式或圖示檔案時，檔案格式現在能正確保留。以前 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具回傳的 CSS、JavaScript、XML 容易被存成 `.bin`，使 Read 拒絕讀取；現在這些檔案及字型、圖示都有對應副檔名。工具搜尋載入的說明上限由 2,048 放寬至 16,384 字元。`claude mcp serve` 的背景 Bash 結果會指出輸出檔名，工具說明也修正了原本承諾會收到、實際卻永遠不會到達的通知。不取得功能旗標的安裝中，claude.ai 連接器預設協商 MCP 協定版本 `2026-07-28`；功能旗標是控制功能是否開啟的開關，可用 `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` 退出這項協商變更。
body.en: File formats are now preserved correctly when returning code, style, or icon files through external tools. Previously, CSS, JavaScript, and XML returned by MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) tools were often saved as `.bin`, causing Read to reject them; now these files as well as fonts and icons receive matching extensions. The description limit loaded by tool search has been expanded from 2,048 to 16,384 characters. Background Bash results in `claude mcp serve` now state the output filename, and tool descriptions have been corrected to remove promises of notifications that never arrive. In installations that do not fetch feature flags, the claude.ai connector negotiates MCP protocol version `2026-07-28` by default. Feature flags are switches controlling whether capabilities are enabled, and you can opt out of this negotiation change using `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy`.

items.original:
Fixed CSS, JavaScript and XML files returned by MCP tools being saved as .bin, which the Read tool refuses; font and icon files now get their own extension too
Fixed `claude mcp serve` background Bash results not naming the output file, and its tool description promising a notification that never arrives
Changed MCP tool descriptions the model loads through tool search to be cut at 16,384 characters instead of 2,048
Changed claude.ai connectors to negotiate MCP protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on installs that fetch no flags; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具背景任務狀態透明，非互動模式不再多餘警示
title.en: Transparent Background Task Status for MCP Tools and Reduced Prompts in Non-Interactive Mode

body.zh-TW: 當你將耗時較長的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具呼叫放到背景執行時，任務動態的同步變得更加清晰。如果你在任務面板或連線客戶端中手動中止了執行中的 MCP 工具，Claude 會得知工具已停止。工具轉移到背景時所跳出的系統通知，現在會顯示完整的任務識別碼以利辨識。在自動化無人值守的非互動工作階段中，若任務完全不需要使用特定 MCP 伺服器，不再跳出多餘的登入驗證提示；無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）與 SDK 工作階段中，延遲完成的登入或重連，不再把 `setMcpServers()` 設定的 MCP 伺服器誤列為使用者自己的伺服器。
body.en: Synchronization of task activity is clearer when running long-running MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) tool calls in the background. If you manually abort a running MCP tool from the task popover or connected client, Claude learns that the tool has stopped. System notifications displayed when tools move to the background now show the full task ID for easy identification. In automated, unattended non-interactive sessions, unnecessary authentication prompts no longer appear when tasks do not require specific MCP servers. In headless mode (an execution mode without a terminal window) and SDK sessions, delayed logins or reconnections no longer mistakenly list MCP servers configured via `setMcpServers()` as user-provided servers.

items.original:
Fixed Claude not being told when you stop a long-running MCP tool call from the tasks panel or a connected client
Fixed the notification for an MCP tool call that moved to the background showing a shortened task id
Fixed non-interactive sessions telling you about MCP servers that need authentication when your request doesn't use them
Fixed an MCP sign-in or reconnect that finishes late in headless and SDK sessions relisting a server set with `setMcpServers()` as your own

title.zh-TW: 子代理工作環境資訊修正，訊息傳遞與技能預載修好
title.en: Fixed Subagent Work Environments, Message Passing, and Skill Preloading

body.zh-TW: 讓子代理（分頭執行子任務的 AI 助理）在獨立工作樹工作時，不再混入主工作階段的 Git 分支、狀態與近期提交。工作樹是同專案的平行副本。Workflow 子代理的技能結果回給呼叫者；代理夥伴首次 SendMessage 不再因工具未載入而失敗。工作階段遭終止後第二次恢復時，也會提醒 Claude 可用 SendMessage 恢復背景子代理。名為 `worker` 的自訂代理，不再於自動模式拒絕通知及任務詳情活動清單中誤顯示為「Agent」。Skill 工具先於回應串流結束時，`allowed-tools` 與 `effort` 不再遺失；兩欄指定可用工具與思考力度，避免 `-p` 的 Bash 指令遭拒。子代理從 `skills` 最多預載 32 個技能、各一次，有 Skill 工具仍可呼叫其餘技能。
body.en: When subagents (AI assistants running subtasks in parallel) work in separate worktrees, they no longer mix in Git branches, status, and recent commits from the primary session. A worktree is a parallel copy of the same project. Workflow subagent skill results now return to callers, and initial SendMessage calls between peer agents no longer fail due to unloaded tools. When resuming a terminated session for a second time, Claude is also reminded to use SendMessage to resume background subagents. Custom agents named `worker` no longer mistakenly appear as "Agent" in auto-mode rejection notices and task detail activity lists. When the Skill tool finishes before the response stream ends, `allowed-tools` and `effort` are no longer lost; these fields specify allowed tools and thinking effort, preventing `-p` Bash commands from being rejected. Subagents preload up to 32 skills once each from `skills`, and can still invoke remaining skills when the Skill tool is available.

items.original:
Fixed subagents in their own linked worktree being shown the parent session's git branch, status and recent commits
Fixed a custom agent named `worker` being shown as "Agent" in auto-mode denial notices and in the activity lists of task detail views
Fixed forked skills invoked from Workflow subagents delivering their results to the main conversation instead of the invoking agent
Fixed in-process agent teammates failing their first SendMessage call until they loaded the tool through tool search
Fixed Claude not being told it can resume background subagents with SendMessage after a session was killed and resumed a second time
Fixed a skill's `allowed-tools` and `effort` being dropped when the Skill tool finished before the response stream ended, which denied the skill's Bash commands in `-p` runs
Changed subagents to preload at most 32 skills from the `skills` field, each once; a subagent with the Skill tool can still invoke the rest

title.zh-TW: 背景任務取消操作分清楚，服務停止時告知收尾
title.en: Distinct Background Task Cancellation Actions and Clear Cleanup Notices on Service Stop

body.zh-TW: 按 `←` 將工作移到背景、還在等工具完成時，停止與繼續工作的操作有不同結果。停止回合會顯示「Backgrounding cancelled」；輸入文字取消背景化，Claude 則繼續在前景工作。`CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS` 不再於子代理後方仍有編輯或命令排隊時搶先背景化，避免後方呼叫過早開始。macOS 或未安裝服務的 Linux 上，`claude agents` 與背景服務一起停止時，執行中的工作階段約一分鐘後停止並顯示通知；期間再次執行 `claude agents` 可避免停止。兩者退出時不再意外啟動新服務，拖延關機或重啟中斷的工作階段。恢復時也不再誤告知 Claude 未完成的背景工作流程可能遭 `TaskStop` 停止。
body.en: When pressing `←` to background work while waiting for tools to finish, stopping versus continuing work now yields distinct outcomes. Stopping a turn displays "Backgrounding cancelled", while typing input cancels backgrounding and lets Claude continue in the foreground. `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS` no longer eagerly backgrounds tasks when edits or commands remain queued behind a subagent, preventing subsequent calls from starting prematurely. On macOS or Linux without installed services, when `claude agents` stops alongside the background service, active sessions stop after roughly one minute with a notification; running `claude agents` again during this window prevents the shutdown. Exiting both no longer inadvertently starts a new service, which previously delayed shutdown or restarted interrupted sessions. Resuming also no longer mistakenly informs Claude that incomplete background workflows may be stopped by `TaskStop`.

items.original:
Added a "Backgrounding cancelled" message when you stop the turn while `←` is waiting for the current tool to finish
Fixed `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS` moving a subagent to the background while an edit or shell command waited behind it, which started that call before the subagent finished
Fixed Claude stopping at the end of the current tool when text typed in the prompt cancelled backgrounding with `←`; Claude now keeps working in the foreground
Fixed `claude agents` starting a new background service as it exited when both were stopped with a session open (for example at a reboot), which could delay shutdown and restart an interrupted session
Fixed Claude being told on resume that an unfinished background workflow may have been stopped by `TaskStop`, which can never be the cause
Changed `claude agents` stopped with its background service (macOS, or Linux without the service installed): running sessions now stop in about a minute unless it is run again, and a notice says so

title.zh-TW: 循環排程快捷鍵明確分工，無人看守重試支援時間上限
title.en: Distinct Shortcuts for Loop Scheduling and Max Wait Times for Unattended Retries

body.zh-TW: 使用 `/loop` 定時檢查時，離開連線畫面與停止循環是兩件事。連接背景工作階段，在閒置提示字元按兩次 Ctrl+C 只會離開連線，待執行的喚醒仍保留；按 Esc 才停止循環，取消待執行喚醒也會顯示通知。用 `←` 移到背景的自定步調 `/loop`，Esc 無法停止的問題已修好。若下次喚醒在程序停止期間到期，循環會停止；現在工作階段會顯示通知，Claude 也會得知。無人看守的重試模式 `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` 可用 `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS` 環境變數（啟動程式前提供的設定），限制遇到 429 用量限制或 529 伺服器超載時的最長等待毫秒數。
body.en: When using `/loop` for scheduled checks, disconnecting from the session and stopping the loop are separate actions. In a connected background session, pressing Ctrl+C twice at an idle prompt only disconnects the client while preserving pending wakeups; pressing Esc stops the loop and notifies you of cancelled wakeups. An issue where Esc could not stop self-paced `/loop` tasks moved to the background with `←` has been fixed. If the next wakeup expires while the process is stopped, the loop terminates; sessions now display a notification and Claude is informed. Unattended retry mode `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` can use the `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS` environment variable (configuration provided before starting a program) to cap maximum wait milliseconds upon encountering 429 rate limits or 529 server overloads.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS` to limit how long unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) waits out 429 and 529 errors
Fixed Esc not stopping a self-paced `/loop` that was moved to the background with `←`; cancelling a pending wakeup now shows a notice
Fixed a background session's `/loop` stopping without notice when its next wakeup came due while the session's process was down; the session now says so and Claude is told
Changed Ctrl+C at the idle prompt of an attached background session to leave a pending `/loop` wakeup alone, so pressing it twice detaches and the loop keeps running; press Esc to stop it

title.zh-TW: 對話倒帶歷程嚴格同步，環境變數與排程狀態精確還原
title.en: Strict Dialogue Rewind History Sync and Accurate Restoration of Variables and Schedules

body.zh-TW: 使用 `/rewind` 倒帶對話或分支出新主題時，不會再遺失提示詞或誤重啟已停止的任務。倒帶後送出的提示詞，在工作階段移到背景或遭終止後恢復時不再遺失，被刪除的回合也不再重現。已停止的排程不再於倒帶後恢復時重啟；對話壓縮後按 Esc 或倒帶，再恢復工作階段時遺失排程的問題也已修好。剛按 `←` 後，用 `↑` 或 Esc 將待發送訊息拉回輸入框，提示詞歷程會保留它。執行 `/resume` 或 `/branch` 後，SessionStart 掛鉤（啟動工作階段時觸發的小程式）寫入 `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` 環境檔案的變數能傳給 Bash 工具；未變更的非同步啟動掛鉤上下文，也不再於每次恢復時重複加入對話。
body.en: Prompts are no longer lost and stopped tasks are not accidentally restarted when using `/rewind` to rewind conversations or branch into new topics. Prompts submitted after rewinding are preserved when sessions move to the background or resume after termination, and deleted turns no longer reappear. Stopped schedules no longer restart upon resuming after a rewind, and an issue where schedules were lost when resuming after conversation compaction followed by Esc or rewind has been fixed. Using `↑` or Esc immediately after pressing `←` to pull a pending message back into the input box preserves it in prompt history. After running `/resume` or `/branch`, variables written to the `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` environment file by SessionStart hooks (small programs triggered on session start) are passed to the Bash tool. Unchanged async startup hook context is also no longer repeatedly added to the conversation across resumes.

items.original:
Fixed an async SessionStart hook's unchanged context being added to the conversation again on every resume
Fixed variables a SessionStart hook writes to `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` not reaching the Bash tool after an in-app `/resume` or `/branch`
